**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Run the probe from its Swift package directory**

When a developer follows the reproduction instructions from the repository root, this command fails because `Package.swift` is under `AirlineEmpireCore/`, not the root. Prefix the command with `cd AirlineEmpireCore` (and adjust the save path), or use `swift run --package-path AirlineEmpireCore ...`, so the documented screenshot-generation process is actually reproducible.
